spans.s:
षुह् r. 4th cl. (सुह्यति)
 1. To bear, to endure.
 2. To be content or
satisfied.
 3. To be able.

सुहसानन mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) Having a cheerful or smiling face.
 E. सु, हस्
laughing, आनन face.
सुहस्ति m. (-स्तिः) One of the ten persons called Purbadharas by the Jainas.

सुहित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
 1. Satiated, satisfied.
 2. Fit, right, suitable.
 3.
Kindly, friendly.
 4. Salutary, beneficial.
 f. (-ता) One of the seven
tongues of AGNI or fire.
 E. सु well, हित placed, &c.

सुहृत्तम mfn. (-मः-मा-मं) Friendly, cordial, kind.
 E. सुहृत् a friend, तमप् aff.

सुहृत्ता f. (-त्ता) Friendship, affection.
 E. सुहृत्, and तल् aff.; also सुहृत्व ।

सुहृद् m. (-हृद् or हृत्)
 1. A friend.
 2. An ally.
 E. सु good, kind, हृद् heart.

सुहृदय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) Good hearted.
 E. सु excellent, हृदय the heart.

सुहृद्बल n. (-लं) The army of an ally.
 E. सुहृद्, बल an army.

सुहृद्भेद m. (-दः) The separation of friends.
 E. सुहृद्, and भेद division.
